name: library-since
title: Assets added to the library since a date
summary: List what the user added to their library on or after a date, newest first

inputs.name: Since
inputs.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD; compute it (e.g. today minus 7 days)

steps.why: Fab filters on the server: no library walk, no cache
steps.check: results[].createdAt (date added) and listing.title; meta.truncated true means raise --limit (default 100)

notes: This is the date the asset was added to the library. For the date Fab published it, use search --filter published_since=YYYY-MM-DD.
